verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs say a single command creates an agent harness that includes "recurring schedules", so the product claims first-party recurring scheduling. This is one thin mention, and nothing shows how schedules are defined or that they apply to workflows as well as the agent harness. Event-triggered workflow runs and polling-based notifications are one-off or reactive triggers, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: scheduling documentation (cron/interval syntax, configuration), evidence that workflows can run on a recurring schedule, management of scheduled jobs (list/pause/history), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules
